text: Implemented shared typed hierarchy: TaskId and SpaceId, non-throwing id smart constructors, DatasetKey, RunKey, DatasetRunDescriptor, DatasetRun, DatasetRunQuery, and DatasetIndex. The index validates non-empty unique RunKey values, resolves typed query criteria, rejects missing/ambiguous one-run queries through DatasetError, and provides DatasetIndex.single for existing FmriDataset callers. Verified with sbt datasetJVM/test datasetJS/test: JVM 31 passed, JS 20 passed.
